message.content: {"caption":"A blue-bordered text box containing the “Prompt 3: Answering with fixed evidence” instructions.","description":"The target is a blue rectangular border enclosing a text prompt. Its teal bold heading reads “Prompt 3: Answering with fixed evidence.” The paragraph instructs the model to answer a benchmark question using a memory workspace and retrieved evidence, treating the workspace as a hint/index and retrieved evidence as authoritative. It says to prefer retrieved evidence when it conflicts with memory and to use the latest exact values for dates, counts, versions, deadlines, and changed facts. For exact-fact questions, compare older and later values in the retrieved evidence rather than stopping at the first matching number, date, or version. For current/latest/how many/average questions, use the last matching mention by turn order and prefer the latest confirmed value over older or planned values. If asked for first/original values, give the original and mention later updates only if useful. If the answer is unsupported, state that the available memory/evidence is insufficient. Be concise while including relevant exact dates, versions, names, and constraints. The listed inputs are Memory workspace ({JSON memory view}), Previous Q/A in this evaluation session ({last five Q/A pairs}), Retrieved evidence ({top retrieved chunks}), and Question ({question}).","figure_type":"other","chart_values":[]}
